about: Clawd's tune config (charkit/tune.py): the trade-offs the loop may accept, the build options it tries, when it stops, and how far each reference can be trusted. The trade-off rules write out the manifest's authority table: the model sheet is the authority for the face's front, 3/4 and profile shape and the chin; the generated (TRELLIS) face is an interpretation, rounder and fuller than the sheet's (manifest: key3d's caution), so its shape checks may get worse when the sheet's matching check gets better, by at most `ratio` times the gain. Depth has no sheet counterpart (the trellis is its authority): face_shape_depth is never traded.

tradeoffs.why: face_front: the sheet is the authority; the TRELLIS face is fuller
face_three_quarter: the sheet is the authority
face_profile: the sheet is the authority
chin: the sheet is the authority
hair_silhouette: the sheet is the authority for how much face the hair shows
body_silhouette: the sheet is the authority; the generated shape and key are interpretations

options.name: geom-hair
options.why: charkit/geom's closed hair shell (docs/GEOM.md): hair_noise ~0.31 -> ~0.19, passes both gates

options.name: anime-base
options.why: charkit's anime base mesh: clean lid and lip rings (face_folds 1014 -> 135 on Clawd)
